findings.title: Silence action is displayed but cannot open its drawer for prom-only list rules
findings.body: The new Grafana list items pass only `promRule`, so the menu can enable and invoke `handleSilence` using the new Prometheus-based ability. That handler sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but the drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. With no ruler rule this condition is always false, leaving users with a clickable “Silence notifications” menu item that has no effect. The drawer/action flow needs to support the Prometheus DTO or the menu item must not be exposed until it can work.

findings.title: Pause remains unavailable for every prom-only Grafana rule in the list
findings.body: `canPause` now incorporates the Prometheus-rule ability specifically for the ruler-free list, but rendering the pause item still requires a Grafana ruler rule. `GrafanaRuleListItem` supplies no `rulerRule`, so this condition is always false even for a user allowed to pause an unprovisioned Grafana rule. As a result, the list loses its pause/unpause action; the pause component needs a Prometheus-compatible input/operation or a separate prom-only implementation.

findings.title: Delete is hidden for prom-only Grafana rules despite a granted delete ability
findings.body: The menu computes `canDelete` from `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, but still renders Delete only when `rulerRule` exists. Both new list entry points render `GrafanaRuleListItem` with only `promRule`, so users with delete permission cannot delete Grafana-managed rules from the alert list. This is avoidable here because the supplied delete handler already closes over the identifier and group identifier rather than using the ruler-rule argument.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable by combined-rule abilities
findings.body: Before this refactor, `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` had access to `CombinedRule.group` and used `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` in the immutable-rule check. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which unconditionally sets `isFederated` to false because only a group identifier is passed. Consequently, federated rules can report update, delete, duplicate, pause, and restore as supported for users with the corresponding permissions, even though the prior UI intentionally blocked those operations. Preserve the federated-group metadata in this ability path or pass the federated status into the ruler ability hook.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose export-with-modifications in the ruler-free list
findings.body: `ModifyExport` is now supported only when `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. The previous ruler-based check used `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule`, which includes both Grafana alerting and recording rules. Since the new list has no ruler rule to provide the old ability as a fallback, Grafana-managed recording rules no longer show “Export with modifications” even though that action was previously available for them. The support check should cover Grafana Prometheus recording rules as well.
